intro: Narain Soothfancy remembers a book he stowed somewhere safe. To reach it you look for his crashed gyrocopter on Land's End Beach, then swim south from there to an island in the South Seas. This follows Translating the Ledger.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I knew that book would come in handy some day! Thankfully, I had the wit and foresight to stow it somewhere safe.

Don't worry, it's in a place that nobody could ever hope to find it! I needed a gyrocopter just to get there the first time. Unfortunately I crashed it on the beach on my way back. It was through that accident that I gained these super-gnomish psychic powers!
Look for my crashed gyrocopter somewhere on Land's End Beach and swim south from there! You'll know the spot when you see it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The book is gone! On top of the dirt mound is a note.
